newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan simplifies currency swaps procedure.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan simplifies currency swaps procedure.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Monday it would further liberalise trading procedures for currency swaps between the Taiwan dollar and foreign currencies.

Under the change, effective immediately, foreign and local institutional and individual investors may conduct currency swaps without related trading documents, the bank said in a statement. The bank gave no further procedural details.
The bank said the move would help Taiwan become an Asia-Pacific financial hub, allow more investors to hedge risk and expand the scale of the foreign exchange market.
The bank opened currency swap trading on January 16, 1995.
